title: Record to a file
description: Write the programme to a file. It is a remux, not a re-encode: the recording is exactly what the encoder already made, so it costs almost no CPU.

directory.title: Folder
directory.description: Where the files go. It is made if it is not there. Empty means a GodwinMix folder inside your Videos folder, or the system temporary folder on a machine with no home directory.

pattern.title: File name
pattern.description: The name, without the extension. {date} is 2026-09-13, {time} is 1030, {datetime} is both, {instance} is this output's id. A split recording gets a five digit number on the end.

format.title: Format
format.description: MP4 is written in fragments, so a machine that loses power leaves a file that still plays up to the last few seconds. Matroska is the alternative and is friendlier to very long recordings.

split_after_minutes.title: Split after
split_after_minutes.description: Start a new file every so many minutes. 0 keeps one file however long the service runs. Splits land on the next keyframe, so the number is approximate by a second or two.

min_free_gb.title: Warn under
min_free_gb.description: Report the recording as degraded when the disk has less than this much room left. It does not stop recording: an operator who is told at 1 GB can act, and a recorder that stopped itself could not be argued with.

label.title: Label
label.description: A name for this recorder, shown wherever the output is listed.
